verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no shared-inbox or team-collaboration feature: no team seats, assignment, or a shared view where several teammates see the same conversation state. What it does document is adjacent at best: labels for tracking conversation state, organization-wide thread listing, IMAP client access, and CC/draft human-in-the-loop flows. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a team shared-inbox capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
